Flat shortcut: the event violates the norm — according to whoever asserts it (statement-layer indexed). Promote to a [`gmeow:ComplianceAssessment`](../classes/gmeow-ComplianceAssessment.md) when the assessor, evidence, or confidence must be first-class. Never entailed: violation is always somebody's judgement (Principles 1, 9, 12).
